title: The Dark Truth About Berserk (manga) #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Berserk (manga) — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Berserk (Japanese: ベルセルク, Hepburn: Beruseruku) is a Japanese manga series created by Kentaro Miura. Set in a medieval Europe–inspired dark fantasy world, the story centers on the swordsman Guts and Griffith, the leader of a mercenary group called the Band of the Hawk.

The psychology underneath Berserk (manga) is simpler and older than the story on top. Miura did not regard dark fantasy as a distinct genre but rather as equivalent to general fantasy. He observed that major Western fantasies like The Lord of the Rings incorporated dark elements, whereas Japanese fantasy, popularized by children's video games like Dragon Quest, often omitted them.
